Z is the most Gehna-specific and best grounded: every spot-checked price (Navaratna bracelet 22,210, Royal Verde pendant 64,320, Fabulous Emerald 30,770, Blue Topaz studs 15,530), the 519-review 4.8 rating, the store address, and even the brand fonts (Nanum Myeongjo, Lato) and #F6B74D gold checked out, and its order-by-date table built from delivery lead times is a genuinely sales-driving idea. X has the most rigorous maths (break-even table, learning-phase arithmetic, rule-gated scale ladder that sums correctly) but leaks internal file references (knowledge.md, DECISIONS.md, context/facts.md) and an AI persona, so it cannot go to a client as is.
